description.title: Disruptive Algorithms for Digital Soil Mapping

latex_breaking_sites.text: 10. Graph Neural Networks \tab \verb{gnn_*} \tab implemented \tab Graph Attention Network (Veli\enc{<U+010D>}{c}kovi\enc{<U+0107>}{c} et al., 2018) over a k-NN co-location graph of profiles (\code{\link[=gnn_build_graph]{gnn_build_graph()}}, with \code{edges = "spatial"}, \code{"feature"} or \code{"hybrid"} and optional self-loops). \code{\link[=gnn_fit]{gnn_fit()}} trains multi-head attention \eqn{\alpha_{ij} = \mathrm{softmax}_j(\mathrm{LeakyReLU}(a^\top [Wh_i \Vert Wh_j]))} by analytic reverse-mode gradients through the grouped softmax <U+2014> verified against central finite differences <U+2014> with residual connections, head averaging, a transductive \code{train_mask} and a closed-form ridge readout. \code{\link[=gnn_fit_ensemble]{gnn_fit_ensemble()}} averages seeds so the comparison against a quantile regression forest is between two ensembles rather than one model and a forest; \code{\link[=gnn_embed]{gnn_embed()}} exposes the learned node embeddings and \code{\link[=gnn_causal_discovery]{gnn_causal_discovery()}} feeds them to Pillar 1's structure learner. \cr
Veli\enc{<U+010D>}{c}kovi\enc{<U+0107>}{c}, P., Cucurull, G., Casanova, A., Romero,

#' | 10. Graph Neural Networks        | `gnn_*`        | implemented | Graph Attention Network (Veli\enc{<U+010D>}{c}kovi\enc{<U+0107>}{c} et al., 2018) over a k-NN co-location graph of profiles ([gnn_build_graph()], with `edges = "spatial"`, `"feature"` or `"hybrid"` and optional self-loops). [gnn_fit()] trains multi-head attention \eqn{\alpha_{ij} = \mathrm{softmax}_j(\mathrm{LeakyReLU}(a^\top [Wh_i \Vert Wh_j]))} by analytic reverse-mode gradients through the grouped softmax <U+2014> verified against central finite differences <U+2014> with residual connections, head averaging, a transductive `train_mask` and a closed-form ridge readout. [gnn_fit_ensemble()] averages seeds so the comparison against a quantile regression forest is between two ensembles rather than one model and a forest; [gnn_embed()] exposes the learned node embeddings and [gnn_causal_discovery()] feeds them to Pillar 1's structure learner. |
